summary: Completed full backend + frontend testing for FORGE AI App Builder. All 16 backend pytest tests passed (root, templates, project CRUD, user isolation, LLM generate via Claude Sonnet 4.5, code update, delete cascade). Frontend: landing page, templates grid, new project modal, workspace navigation, chat panel, prompt -> Claude generation -> live preview rendering, tab switching (preview/code), code editor, back button — all working. One real issue found with copy button error handling.

ui_bugs.issue: navigator.clipboard.writeText() is not wrapped in try/catch. In iframe/sandbox/non-secure contexts the Promise rejects with 'Write permission denied', producing an uncaught error and (in dev mode) a full-screen React 'Uncaught runtime errors' overlay that blocks all subsequent interaction (e.g. tab switching, back button). Reproduced in Playwright preview iframe.

issues: Engine stats card shows 'Templates 0 / Projects 0' during initial load (before fetch resolves). Minor flash; consider hiding stats until loading=false.

action_items: Wrap navigator.clipboard.writeText() in PreviewPanel.copyCode() with try/catch and surface a toast.error fallback. Also add a noop for environments where navigator.clipboard is undefined. This will prevent the React dev-mode error overlay from blocking UI when running in iframes / restricted contexts.
Optional: hide engine stats during loading to avoid 0/0 flash on first paint.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 264: logger.exception used inside generate_code, but logger is declared at line 318 (after include_router). Works at runtime due to module-level definitions order, but stylistically the logger setup should be defined immediately after imports.

server.py call_claude(): builds a manual context_block with 'Assistant previously generated code' summaries — this is a workaround. Since LlmChat is created fresh per call with the same session_id, the emergentintegrations library may already maintain history. Consider verifying or simplifying.
PreviewPanel.jsx: clipboard copy + LiveError both lack robust error UX (raw error spew). Acceptable for a dev/preview tool but worth hardening.
Workspace.jsx updateCode(): silently swallows PUT /code errors with only console.error — consider a debounced toast on persistent failure.
Frontend: no rate limiting / debouncing on PUT /projects/{id}/code — every keystroke in the LiveEditor sends a request. Add debounce (e.g., 500ms).

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all critical flows pass; copy button has error-handling gap)

test_credentials: N/A — single-user mode, X-User-Id header auto-generated client-side.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed projects under random TEST_userA_/TEST_userB_ user IDs and cleanup in teardown_module.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend stable — Claude Sonnet 4.5 generation tested end-to-end (~7s per call). Pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_api.py covers root, templates, full CRUD, isolation, LLM generate, delete cascade. Run via: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest backend/tests/test_api.py. The only material issue is the unhandled clipboard rejection in PreviewPanel which shows up in restricted browsing contexts only.
